 cursor cur_procdesc is
 select description
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = :valid_donproc_codes.procedure_code;

 if :valid_donproc_codes.procedure_code is not null then

/*
 open cur_procdesc;
 fetch cur_procdesc
 into :valid_donproc_codes.proc_code_desc;
 if cur_procdesc%NOTFOUND then
 :valid_donproc_codes.proc_code_desc := 'Not available';

*/

 szDonorID := :donor_lists.donor_id;

end;

 if lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :donor_lists.call_date, :donor_lists.s_call_date);

*/

 --if
 -- Change home phone number to prefered phone number 
 -- Changed by Kishore on 12/14/2011
 begin
 select b.last_name || ', ' || b.first_name || ' '|| b.middle_name,
 b.gender, b.date_of_birth, b.blood_type,

/* To select donor since*/

/* To find no of years */

 begin

 begin

 :donor_lists.s_difference := to_char(V_HR) || ':' || lpad(to_char(V_MIN),2,'0');

 begin

Procedure lock_return_donor(pl_list_id in varchar2,pl_nxt_rownum in number,
 pl_donor_id out varchar2,pl_pre_rownum out number) IS

 cursor pickup_donor is select donor_id from donor_lists where list_id=pl_list_id and 
 locked_by is null and call_code in ('NOCNT','NOELG') or
 (call_code='MSG' and sysdate < call_after) or
 (call_code='CLBCK' and sysdate < call_after);
 
 v_donor_id varchar2(10);
 v_count NUMBER:=0;
 Begin 

 open pickup_donor;
 begin
 loop
 FETCH pickup_donor into v_donor_id;
 if pickup_donor%rowcount > v_count then
 v_count:=pickup_donor%rowcount;
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 close pickup_donor;
 
 /* Set the count 1 when the loop is completed */
 if v_count=pl_nxt_rownum then 
 v_count:=1;
 open pickup_donor;
 FETCH pickup_donor into v_donor_id; 
 close pickup_donor;
 end if;

 end;
 
 
 Update donor_lists set locked_by=LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid where list_id=pl_list_id and donor_id=v_donor_id; 

 pl_donor_id:=v_donor_id;
 pl_pre_rownum:=v_count; 
 commit;
 close pickup_donor;
 Exception
 When others then
 null;
 End;

FUNCTION IS_TERM_ALLOWED(c_user_id varchar2,c_code_type varchar2,c_code varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
c_view_level number;
c_inter_level number := NULL;
chk_all number;

BEGIN

 /* Check whether user has ALL access */

 /* check whether the given code and type has been defined in one of
 the access classes of the user */
 
 begin
 select max(b.inter_level)
 into c_inter_level
 from valid_acl_codes a , valid_user_access_classes b
 where b.user_id = c_user_id
 and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and a.access_class=b.access_class
 and a.access_code_type=c_code_type
 and a.access_code_value = 'ALL'
 and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 NULL ;
 end;
 if c_inter_level is null then

 begin
 select max(b.inter_level)
 into c_inter_level
 from valid_acl_codes a , valid_user_access_classes b
 where b.user_id = c_user_id
 and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and a.access_class=b.access_class
 and a.access_code_type=c_code_type
 and a.access_code_value = c_code
 and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 return FALSE ;
 end;
 end if;

 if c_code_type='PROPR' then
 begin
 select view_level
 into c_view_level
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=c_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR');
 
 if c_view_level < c_inter_level then
 return TRUE;
 else
 return FALSE;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 return FALSE;
 end;
 end if;

END;
